content.title: April Fools' Day: Fun pranks to pull on your kids and family
content.text: Skip to content by: Alyssa Mueller Posted: Mar 31, 2026 / 11:41 AM CDT Updated: Mar 31, 2026 / 11:41 AM CDT SHARE KANSAS CITY, Mo. — With April Fools’ Day right around the corner, families are being reminded that the best jokes are the ones everyone can laugh about. Early childhood experts at The Goddard School are sharing a list of lighthearted, kid-friendly pranks designed to keep the day fun without any tears or confusion. See the latest headlines in Kansas City and across Kansas, Missouri Instead of over-the-top tricks, the focus is on simple surprises that spark giggles at home: A “frozen cereal” breakfast that turns a morning routine into a silly surprise Milk that changes color, adding a playful twist to the breakfast table Googly eyes popping up on fridge items and lunch snacks A cup of “juice” that jiggles instead of pours — like using Jello View the latest headlines from Kansas City, Missouri, and Kansas at fox4kc.com All the pranks listed above are easy, mess-free and help children enjoy the day. The key is making sure kids are in on the joke by the end, not left feeling tricked or upset. The school also noted that playful moments like these can actually help support social-emotional development, teaching kids about humor, trust and connection in a safe environment.
